evidence_spans: Memory fit requires only 64 bits of state per 4 KiB page and can be updated on every main-memory access with only a 1.2% overhead of OS kernel notification processing.
Memory fit requires only 64 bits of state per 4 KiB page and can be updated on every main-memory access with only a 1.2% overhead of OS kernel notification processing.
We have implemented memory fit and STM in a BOOMv3 RISC-V processor running Linux 6.6.
CLM-ARCH-0197.statement: Memory fit updates incur a 1.2% overhead of OS kernel notification processing.

extra_quotes: We have implemented memory fit and STM in a BOOMv3 RISC-V FPGA processor and incorporated support in Linux 6.6.
We use the FireSim prototype described in Section 4 and compare STM with Linux TPP [15].
Exploring memory fit for large (2MB) and huge (1GB) pages is future work.
A Small BOOM core, running at 18MHz, cannot generate enough traffic to saturate the FPGA host’s HBM or introduce significant queueing at the HBM interface.
